fields.g: completed regular-season games with an ffopportunity row
fields.act: season-to-date actual PPR points (same source as exp)
fields.trend3: last up to 3 games: per-game exp/act/res, the residual per game over earlier games (prior_res_pg), and [week, exp, act] rows

attribution: ffverse/ffopportunity weekly expected fantasy points (release v1.0.0-data). No stated data licence beyond GPL-3 code; credit given. The expected model was fitted on earlier seasons and is not retrained in-season.

notes: Residual is descriptive. E12 (research/trend-intelligence/OPPORTUNITY_VS_PRODUCTION.md) found no pre-registered out-of-sample forecasting use after controlling for workload and production.
Touchdowns dominate the residual in small samples. A player missing from the source is unknown, not zero.
Players with under 2.0 expected PPR per game are omitted for size.
